story: Enable story creation from within the TUI without requiring external slash commands. Users should be able to create a new story directly in the TUI interface instead of being prompted to use /engineering-process:story which is not accessible inside the TUI.

jtbd.context: When working interactively in the TUI interface and wanting to start a new engineering workflow
jtbd.job: I want to initiate a new story workflow without leaving the TUI context
jtbd.outcome: So I can maintain my flow state and start engineering tasks seamlessly from within my current working environment
